0022600167.text: The Celtics come in at 4-1, including a 4-0 home mark and a 0-1 road record, and they are on a four-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Atlantic (1 game back) and 3rd in the East. The Rockets are 6-1 overall, 3-0 at home and 3-1 on the road, riding a one-game win streak, and are 2nd in the Southwest (0.5 games back) and 2nd in the West. Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness) and Mitchell Robinson (rest), while Houston is without Steven Adams (calf strain) and has Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Reed Sheppard (back) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions; the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1 and with Boston's 114-93 win in Houston on February 4, 2026 being the most recent meeting.
